ja: ― 優 美 な る 蒼 き 騎 士 　戦 場 へ ―
『新機動戦記ガンダムＷ』より、トレーズ・クシュリナーダの専用機体
「トールギスＩＩ」がＲＧシリーズで商品化。
一部に新規造形パーツを採用し、設定に準じた機体形状を徹底再現。
●　トールギスＩＩの機体形状を新規造形を交えて徹底再現！
頭部
ヒロイックなフェイス部、ボリューム感のある頭頂部を新規造形で再現。
マスクの赤い差し色もパーツ分割で再現。
カラーリング
胴体・腰部・バックパックなど、ブルーを基調とした成形色で再現。
設定に基づきつつもＲＧ準拠の配色にて立体化。
●　表情用平手ハンドパーツを新規造形で立体化！
新規造形にて両手を重ね合わせた平手ハンドパーツが付属。トールギスＩＩを象徴する「ドーバーガンを携えた登場シーン」を再現可能。
●　１／１４４スケール「トレーズ・クシュリナーダ」フィギュアが新規造形で付属。
●　新規デザインのリアリスティックデカールが付属。
付属武装 ： ドーバーガン ／ ビームサーベル ／ シールド
１／１４４スケール組み立て式プラモデル
対象年齢：１５才以上
製品素材：ＰＳ・ＡＢＳ・ＰＰ
・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません

en: - The graceful blue knight goes to the battlefield -
From "Mobile Suit Gundam W", Treize Kushrinada's special aircraft
"Tallgeese II" is commercialized in the RG series.
Some new modeling parts are used to thoroughly reproduce the aircraft shape according to the setting.
● Thoroughly reproduces the aircraft shape of Tallgeese II with new modeling!
head
The heroic face and voluminous top of the head are recreated with new modeling.
The red accent color of the mask is also reproduced by dividing the parts.
coloring
The torso, waist, backpack, etc. are reproduced in a blue-based molding color.
Although based on the setting, it is three-dimensional with an RG-compliant color scheme.
● Three-dimensional facial expression open hand parts with new modeling!
A newly sculpted flat hand part with both hands overlapped is included. You can recreate the scene in which Tallgeese II appears with the Dover gun, which symbolizes it.
● 1/144 Scale "Traise Kushrinada" figure is included as a new model.
● Newly designed realistic decals are included.
Attached weapons: Dover gun / Beam saber / Seal
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/ABS/PP
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
